baseURL.description: Root of the model server. A trailing /v1 is fine.

enumDescriptions: llama-server /infill: the server builds the prompt.
Any /v1/completions server, with the Qwen Coder prompt format.

model.description: Model name sent with each request. A proxy such as llama-swap uses it to pick the model.

guide.description: The plan: one Markdown file, or a folder whose .md files are all read. A relative path inside the repository. Read from .plan-complete.json only.

guideTokenBudget.description: Most plan tokens in one prompt.

prefixLines.description: Lines of code before the cursor.

suffixLines.description: Lines of code after the cursor.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of one model request.

debounceMs.description: Wait in the server before a request, so fast typing sends one.

useGuide.description: Put the plan into the prompt.

useScope.description: Put what encloses the cursor, and the editor context, into the prompt.

context.description: What the editor gathers from the real language server for each request.

signature.description: The signature of the call at the cursor.

symbols.description: The type and the member that enclose the cursor, to rank the plan.

timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the language server.

tokenBudget.description: Most tokens of editor context in one prompt.

scoring.description: Points that a plan section earns. Subject to change between versions.

glob.description: The front-matter `files` of the section match the edited file.

file.description: The section names the edited file.

symbol.description: For each front-matter symbol near the cursor.

type.description: The section names a type that encloses the cursor.

member.description: The section names the function or the property that encloses the cursor.

codeSpan.description: For each name in a code span that is near the cursor, three at most.

heading.description: A word of the heading is near the cursor.

words.description: Times the share of the section's words that are near the cursor.
